# `ResourceReadInterceptorInterface`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Interceptor\ResourceReadInterceptorInterface`

**Interface** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Interceptor/ResourceReadInterceptorInterface.php)

Public extension point wrapping every resources/read — static resources
and resource templates alike, whatever the registration path.
Implementations run in configured order (first = outermost) and decide
whether to call $next: auditing, tracing, ACL.

Throw \Mcp\Exception\ResourceReadException to reject the call with
a client-visible message; any other exception becomes an opaque internal
error. To pretend the resource does not exist, throw
\Mcp\Exception\ResourceNotFoundException.

## Methods

### intercept()

```php
intercept(Interceptor\ResourceReadContext $context, callable $next): mixed
```
